exposure: length of stay in hospital for activity restriction
outcome: latency period from diagnosis to delivery
cohort: The study included 110 women (56 singletons; 54 twin gestations) admitted to a High Risk Obstetrics Unit at Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre with an ultrasound-identified short cervix (<=25 mm) between 2005 and 2011.
finding: The mean latency from diagnosis to delivery was 62.6 days, with a mean gestational age at delivery of 33.9 weeks, and preterm birth occurred in 70% of all women.
